concepts.name: Bold shapes
concepts.prompt:
PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: radical minimalist flat graphic vector art, like a very simple motion-design explainer made from 15 to 25 oversized geometric shapes. The ENTIRE forest uses only FIVE oversized tree silhouettes: three simple round blob tree crowns in ochre/coral, two dark teal triangles for pines. TWO broad smooth hill curves, ONE flat blue-green pond oval, THREE huge cream cloud blobs, ONE solid pale sun circle. Each object is exactly one solid color. Optional two tiny drifting leaf shapes, one small crescent ripple. NO small distant trees, NO realistic leaves, NO texture, NO gradients, NO shading, NO painterly detail, NO mountain crags, NO complex reflections. Flat blocks of muted color, enormous readable shapes and very strong negative space. A stylish graphic cartoon almost like screenprinted mid-century animation, obviously easy to make every shape drift or sway. The left UI and right landscape use warm sage/charcoal/ochre accents for one intentional composed interface. Full scene should feel adult, quietly playful, boldly simplified.

concepts.name: Pixel autumn
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE complete 16:9 television home-screen concept, all UI and art composed together. A standalone polished screenshot, not a sheet of alternatives, not shown inside a physical TV or room.
Reference image: supplied screenshot is a LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY. Replace its photographic landscape completely. Keep the liked LEFT PANE layout: dark restrained vertical pane occupies 31 percent of screen, small SOL / HOME at top, large 4:24 clock and small Saturday, October 17 date, six compact real-logo app tiles in a two-column three-row grid for YouTube, Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Spotify, Apple TV. Subtle warm focus outline on YouTube. Keep readable calm mature typography, generous spacing.
Keep bottom utility navigation, small labels "All apps", "Inputs", "Ambient", "Settings", "Watching", with "56°" and "Clear" at bottom right. No extra widgets.
The right 69 percent is a living illustrated AUTUMN landscape filling the composition from top to bottom utility strip, not a picture hung on a wall, not a photograph in a rectangular outline. Integrate its edge naturally against the UI pane. Forest, distant hills, a little water and a generous sky. Warm muted amber, pine green, rust, slate blue; calm, atmospheric, clean, modern, sophisticated. No trailing houseplants, neon, purple UI gradients, excessive decoration, visual noise, photographic textures, stock website cards or huge headline text.
Design a scene that can LATER be assembled from a few reusable native-drawn layers: separable clouds, tree crowns/branches, a water surface, foreground reeds and a handful of leaves. Show a representative beautiful still frame; no annotations, arrows, asset labels, sprite sheet or animation motion blur.

Art direction: original cozy 16-bit pixel-art autumn woodland in the inviting rural-life-game spirit requested by the user, without copying a particular game scene, characters or assets. Clearly visible crisp square pixels, consistent pixel grid, nearest-neighbor aesthetic, limited cohesive palette, charming layered forest, small reflective pond, drifting chunky clouds, little golden reeds and clear clusters of orange leaves. Rich enough to feel like an explorable pixel world, restrained enough for a TV background. No tiny busy objects, farm chores, inventory UI, animals or characters. The left panel remains a modern TV launcher with recognisable app logos and restrained small pixel-inspired typography, not a game HUD.

concepts.name: Paper world
concepts.prompt:
PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: a tiny handcrafted paper theater, blatantly made of layered colored cardstock. Large smooth cutout shapes with visible thick cream PAPER EDGES and short soft cast shadows. Dramatically simplified woodland using just SIX rounded scalloped tree crowns, skinny curved paper trunks, THREE sweeping layers of hills, a flat turquoise paper pond and FOUR chunky overlapping paper cloud strips. No individual leaves or detailed treetops, no photographic mountains, no photographic trees, no rock textures. Restrained shallow 3D orthographic paper-craft lighting only to show the separate layered paper silhouettes; not a realistic rendered forest. Colors: warm ivory, mustard, rusty orange, pale sage, deep petrol. A mobile-like gently hanging paper leaf group frames upper right. Entire scene could be separated into 10 or 12 cutouts for animation. Modern tactile cartoon art with big charming shapes, lots of breathing room. The dark left launcher pane is flat matte cardstock with restrained cream typography.

concepts.name: Animated forest
concepts.prompt:
PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: unmistakable friendly CARTOON television-animation background, bold smooth hand-inked outlines, large curving stylized trees, only TWO flat cel-shaded tones per object, no realistic texture and no painterly detail. A close forest grove with three quirky curved dark trunks, oversized leafy amber canopies built from about six puffy rounded leaf-masses, simple rounded distant blue hills, pale peach sky with two huge expressive puffy outlined clouds, a small blue stream curling across foreground, a few bold bent reeds and big individual falling leaves. No huge realistic mountain vista, no dozens of detailed realistic trees, no complex lake reflection. Organic slightly wonky drawn lines and a peaceful warm Saturday-morning animation feel, sophisticated calm arrangement. Big separable tree boughs, cloud puffs, reed tufts, and a few ripple lines suggest many subtle moving parts. No characters, critters or faces. This must look like a cartoon frame, not an illustration traced from a photograph.
